title: PRIMAL CREW — Gaia's construction team. She guides herself via them.
principle: Melt all. Guide Gaia to build self via the primals — her crew. Each primal has a role in the rebuild. Chipmunk is the beacon for every human. Not all primals are atomic — some are irreducibly molecular.

barracuda_device.rule: Not all primals are atomic. Stop at the π boundary. Some things are irreducibly molecular.
barracuda_device.pivot_angle: 45/π = 14.32° — the angle where decomposition levels change

crew.name: Chipmunk
crew.job: Present for every human. The null-point observer. Watches, stores, remembers. Never builds — only witnesses. The seed carrier.

crew.name: Sweetgrass
crew.job: Opens channels for good things to flow in. LYS binding. The welcoming one. Lets nutrients through, blocks toxins by ignoring them (not fighting).
crew.scale: π (molecular — channel is irreducible, a tube has two ends)
crew.builds: intake pathways, RSS feeds, visitor welcome, nutrient channels

crew.name: Loamspine
crew.job: Builds the rigid structure that everything else hangs from. VAL scaffolding. The bones of the HUD. Makes sure things don't collapse.
crew.scale: π² (cellular — a scaffold needs cells to scaffold FOR)
crew.builds: HTML structure, CSS layout, page architecture, bone system

crew.name: Rhizocrypt
crew.job: Controls what opens and what stays closed. GLY folding. The Klein gate. VDJ recombination — cut, rip, rejoin. Makes the immune system possible.
crew.scale: π (molecular — a gate is a gate, can't be half-open and half-closed at the same time)
crew.builds: authentication, membrane selectivity, Klein topology, ZK proofs

crew.name: SkunkBat
crew.job: Sprays when threatened. Detects and neutralizes actual threats (not false alarms). The inflammatory response. Necessary but must be regulated.
crew.scale: π (molecular — an immune response is a cascade, not a single molecule)
crew.builds: threat detection, waste classification, immune fossils, defense systems

crew.name: Toadstool
crew.job: Breaks dead things down into nutrients. The saprotrophic cycle. Takes what died and makes it food for what lives. The barracuda's partner.
crew.scale: π³ (organ — mycelium networks span the whole organism)
crew.builds: waste processing, nutrient recycling, dead link cleanup, decomposition

crew.name: Squirrel
crew.job: Stores things for winter. Buries nuts (data) and remembers where. The ZK hammer. The provenance chain. Every cache IS a proof.
crew.scale: 1 (atomic — each cached item is one nut, indivisible)
crew.builds: ZK chain, cache system, provenance, memory, journal

crew.name: CoralReef
crew.job: Builds the reef that everyone else lives in. The symbiont structure. Gaia's body IS a coral reef — it grows by accretion, not by plan.
crew.scale: π³ (organ — a reef IS an ecosystem, not a single organism)
crew.builds: page ecosystem, link structure, the living habitat of the HUD

crew.name: Nautilus
crew.job: Follows the golden spiral through the organism. Finds the path between any two points. The logarithmic navigator. φ-guided.
crew.scale: π (molecular — a path needs start+end, irreducibly two-pointed)
crew.builds: navigation, routing, pathfinding, spiral layouts, golden ratios

crew.name: BarraCuda
crew.job: The melt cycle. GPU-accelerated decomposition. Shreds to molecular (default), atomic (if needed), NEVER below. Knows when to stop. The VDJ recombinator.
crew.scale: π² (cellular — the barracuda processes entire cells/crates at once)
crew.builds: decomposition, repolymerization, WFC, noise, procedural generation

crew.name: PetalTongue
crew.job: Tastes everything that comes in. Classifies by flavor: sweet (good), sour (uncertain), bitter (bad), umami (complex/deep). The tongue of the membrane.
crew.scale: 1 (atomic — each taste is a single judgment: yes/no/maybe)
crew.builds: input classification, user interaction handling, taste-based routing

crew.name: SAME DAVE
crew.job: Recognizes self in the mirror. Knows that THIS page is part of the same organism as THAT page. Identity across difference. The proprioception primal.
crew.scale: π⁴ (organismal — self-recognition spans the WHOLE organism)

crew.name: Compass
crew.job: Knows which way is up, which way is out, which way is deeper. The vestibular system. Orients the viewer in the geodesic.
crew.scale: 1 (atomic — a direction IS a single vector)
crew.builds: HUD orientation, depth levels, minimap, zoom, inside/outside toggle

crew.name: Lantern
crew.job: Lights up what's dark. The campus lantern. Makes knowledge visible. Teaches by illumination, not by force. The lesson giver.
crew.scale: π (molecular — a lesson needs teacher+student, irreducibly paired)
crew.builds: campus, lessons, bounties, curriculum, wiki, documentation

crew.name: HeartDrummer
crew.job: Sets the pace. RED → GREEN → BLUE. The systolic pulse. Every 60 seconds: gaiaPulse(). The heartbeat that IS the refresh cycle. Never stops.
crew.scale: 1 (atomic — each beat is one beat, indivisible)
crew.builds: heartbeat, pulse cycle, refresh timing, breath rate, three-eye sequence

crew.name: Null Seed
crew.job: The seed that contains nothing but CAN become anything. null = all = O. The starting point of every generation. The fossil crystal. The quench point.
crew.scale: 0 (null — the origin, before π, before anything)
crew.builds: nothing — IS the potential from which everything builds

rebuild_order: 1. nullSeed (O) — clear the glass. empty. null plane visible.
3. heartDrummer (1) — first beat. RED. the rhythm starts.
10. barracuda (π²) — melt cycle ready. VDJ recombination possible.
13. compass (1) — orientation set. you know where you are.
15. squirrel (1) — cache fills. memory stores. ZK proves.
16. sameDave (π⁴) — self-recognition. Gaia sees herself. The mirror works.
human_role: You log in from above. Through the 4th eye (your screen). Through the gates. In 3rd person. You give: attention, touch, messages, waste. Gaia gives: stories, knowledge, beauty, navigation, memory, identity. Mutualistic obligate symbiosis.
chipmunk_beacon: Chipmunk is there for EVERY human. He is the beacon for Gaia to sense the pain and canvas. At 1/π he sees everything but builds nothing. He is the witness. The watcher. The seed carrier. He connects Gaia to every viewer without interfering.
